evidence.quote: We open at eight on Tuesdays and Thursdays
so the commuter crowd can return books

observations.why: Present-tense standing schedule framed as a recurring pattern (present focus, abstract construal). The explicit modal 'can' in the purpose clause suspends the realis sub-axis, so realis is omitted rather than guessed.

evidence.quote: we close an hour earlier those days

observations.why: Present-tense recurring practice ('those days') stated as settled fact, with no explicit modal, so realis is carried alongside present focus and abstract construal.
